findings.body: The previous advisory remains open. Both views read events.jsonl without the writer guard at src/forge/board.py:203–204. On Windows, an overlapping read can make this replacement raise PermissionError, failing the enclosing worker, reader, review or test command merely while recording progress. Add bounded replacement retries, following the existing handling at src/forge/codex.py:532–539.
findings.title: Handle Windows readers holding the progress file open

findings.body: The previous advisory remains open. A structured missing-session result is decoded with error_during_execution before its diagnostic, so the worker's prefix check at src/forge/worker.py:443–445 misses it. The reader checks only stderr at src/forge/story.py:738–740, while this decoder returns the diagnostic through stdout. Both paths therefore refuse instead of starting the intended fresh session. Recognize the missing-session diagnostic in both callers while preserving other failure details. The [upstream reproduction](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/40609) confirms this structured response.
findings.title: Preserve missing-session recovery for structured Claude errors
